text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Based on the recommendation by the support group, the SFOE prepares a draft version of the detailed plan and initiates the consultation and participation procedure in the cantons.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Dans les cas où la marge de manœuvre pour plusieurs zones de planification n’est pas considérée comme suffisante, l’entreprise requérante peut, avec l’approbation des cantons concernés, proposer à l’OFEN une seule zone de planification.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Interested persons, organisations and associations have the opportunity to submit comments and statements of position within the scope of the consultation and participation procedure.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "L’entreprise requérante élabore au moins deux corridors de planification avec la participation des cantons concernés et fournit les documents nécessaires à l’Office fédéral de l’énergie (OFEN).", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Once the above procedure has been concluded, the SFOE finalises the detailed plan and initiates a consultation of public authorities.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Après entente avec le groupe d’accompagnement, l’OFEN peut renoncer à la détermination formelle de la zone de planification.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Within two months after the conclusion of the consultation of public authorities, the SFOE petitions the Federal Council to specify the planning zone.", "severity": 1, "before": ""}]}
